comparison.objective: Move a ball retainer to its stop and roll a slide member between its rollers; candidate snaps a collet into an eccentric ring.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-axis rail alignment and rolling insertion through a retainer versus localized groove capture followed by changing-axis tilt/roll snap engagement.
comparison.success_condition: Member reaches the far stop in riding position after valid retainer contact versus collet remains circumferentially retained and resists withdrawal.
comparison.reason: This is the closest motion-language neighbor, but the tested constraint is rail/roller traversal, not eccentric-lip snap capture. Candidate snap-force threshold is missing.
